title: Mahdist State
summary: The Mahdist State was the Sudanese polity built around the Mahdi, who became known in June 1881. After the Mahdists took Khartoum in January 1885, the state was governed from Omdurman, and the Mahdi's successor, Abdallahi, ruled as Khalifa. It ended after its last battle at Karari, outside Omdurman, in September 1898.

uncertainty.note: Start is taken as the fall of Khartoum in January 1885; the encyclopedia entry dates the Mahdi becoming known in June 1881, so the start is contested.

as_recorded.value: In January of the following year Khartoum fell to the Mahdists

importance.justification: The state ruled from Omdurman until its last battle at Karari in 1898, which the 1898 Battle of Omdurman record covers.
